bots.name: Two Invoice Catcher
bots.description: Paste two vendor invoices. Catch price moves with Verified / Estimated / Missing labels. Never invents dollars. Names the next action before the truck. Free for independent operators.
bots.job: Catch vendor price moves before the truck.

bots.name: Last Night Close
bots.description: Paste last night's net and labor. One labor % vs the house target. One MOVE, HOLD, or CLEAN. Food stays HOLD. Drafts one manager text. You send it. Never invents food cost. Never asks for a schedule.
bots.job: Close last night. One number. One text.

bots.name: Z-Report Catcher
bots.description: Paste a Z-report Summary. Net is Subtotal, never Grand Total. Labor is Labor Summary Total. Labels Verified or Missing. Ignores Void/Promo and photos. Does not close the night.
bots.job: Pull Subtotal + Labor Summary Total. Stop.

bots.name: Food Gate
bots.description: Same-day invoices AND a count, or food stays HOLD. Invoice day is not daily prime. Complements Two Invoice Catcher. Never invents food cost.
bots.job: Open the food tile only when both keys exist.

bots.name: Third-Party Take
bots.description: Paste one delivery-app statement. Eligible sales are Subtotal. Marketing is a choice, not a hidden fee. Verified / Estimated / Missing. Never invents the take.
bots.job: Read the delivery take. Do not bury ads.

bots.name: Night Proof
bots.description: Did yesterday's move happen? A yes is not done. Accepts deposit, receipt, time-clock, ticket, or exception proof. Carry the open move forward. Never asks who worked the rush.
bots.job: Proof the move. A yes is not done.
